subject: Anna Callahan Campaign Launch
overview: Joshua Chaisin spoke at a campaign launch event for State Representative candidate Anna Callahan, sharing his experience with student loan debt and calling for public college funding and debt cancellation.

items.title: Introduction of Joshua Chaisin
items.summary: A speaker introduced Middlesex Community College student Joshua Chaisin to share his personal experience with student debt.

items.title: Remarks on Student Debt and Endorsement
items.summary: Joshua Chaisin described how student debt has affected his education and personal life, advocating for debt forgiveness and endorsing Anna Callahan's platform.
